meta.title: Marking a template as BOQ hides the delivery-location column
gaps: Navigate to Templates and create a new pricing template; no catalog flow or confirmed route is provided.
Tick BOQ and assert that buyer_hub disappears from the template editor's widget list.
Save the pricing template and assert its BOQ label in the template-management list.
Set the conditional company switch or verify that saving changes boq_in_erfx_allowed?; the catalog cannot change company settings or read this flag.
